name: ai_vector_search
problem: LLM answers need grounding in your own data via semantic retrieval.
glue: embeddings turns documents+queries into vectors; vector_store indexes and does ANN search; rag stitches retrieved context into the prompt via prompt_registry; token_cost_logging records spend.
steps: Chunk + embed source docs (embeddings) and upsert into vector_store.
On query: embed the query, ANN-search vector_store, assemble context.
Render the grounded prompt from prompt_registry and call llm_client.
